description: Dye leather horse armor only where it is meant to be dyed!

releases.notes:
- Changed (and simplified) armor overlay injection to render overlay after vanilla armor render instead of wholesale replacing it (resolves conflict with Shiny Horses). #6
- Added log message on mod load to let you know that Dyed is running (requires FAPI on Fabric now).

- Disabled vanilla armor layer rendering (fixes conflict with ETF) #2
- Restructured to Mojmap style (and rewritten in Mojmap)
- Added NeoForge support

- Specified display test on Forge
- Set Forge ordering to none
- Slight code compactification

- Replaced access wideners/transformers with accessors/invokers
- Removed logger
- Forge versions now enabled for all compatible patch subversions
- Forge versions now built with Yarn + Architectury Loom

- Simplified to inject directly into the render method #1
- Updated to Loom 1.0 [Fabric]

- Changed ModifyArg to Redirect
- Removed Minecraft version from mod version
- Migrated to SLF4J for 1.19
- Added Forge port [Forge]
